description: In every PA-model, a nonzero list code is the constructor applied to its decoded head and tail.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.cons_head_tail_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (c : M)
  (hc : c ≠ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listCons.value
      ![Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listHead.value ![c],
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listTail.value ![c]] =
    c
